catalog.name: Network infrastructure
catalog.description: This collection includes information on voltage flows and quality, and provides the mapping of high voltage power lines. This information is useful to support assessments of the energy system as a whole and to identify potential critical issues.

members.name: Municipalities with Primary Substations with flow reversal
members.description: Municipal-scale map of reverse energy events detected in 2015 in primary substations, categorized according to duration. The data concerning the flow cabins owned by e-distribuzione and the data for the years 2015 and/or 2020 are visible. These data only include information from the company Enel Distribuzione, which covers around 85% of the energy served by primary substations in Italy (the remaining 15% is handled by around 100 other distributors). The data refer only to the primary substations WITH flow inversion, they do not report the substations WITHOUT flow inversion. The mapped information is correct as regards the municipalities with substations with 1% or 5% flow inversion, it is uncertain for the municipalities not mentioned (they could be from other operators with flow inversion or from e-distribuzione with zero inversion).

members.description:
Map of conventional areas under primary cabins on the national territory.
Each conventional area is characterized by a reference code composed of 11 alphanumeric characters.
The map is managed by GSE.
For more information visit the page Interactive map of primary cabins.

members.name: Distribution network continuity indicators
members.description:
This collection includes information on the continuity of the electricity distribution service, made available annually by the Italian Regulatory Authority for Energy, Networks and Environment (ARERA). The data are transmitted and uploaded to the portal by distribution system operators (DSOs), in accordance with the established procedures, and subsequently made available for publication, consultation and sharing purposes. The indicators are calculated by the Authority on the basis of the information provided by distribution companies.

Source: ARERA

members.name: Duration of long unplanned interruptions at municipal level
members.description:
Average total annual duration of long unplanned interruptions (i.e. lasting more than 3 minutes) per low-voltage (LV) user, excluding interruptions originating from the power system, expressed in minutes/LV user, at municipal level, for the period 2020-2024.
Municipal data are derived from provincial data published by ARERA and assigned to each municipality based on the number of inhabitants and the corresponding degree of concentration:
  • high concentration (1_AC): municipalities with a population exceeding 50,000 inhabitants according to the latest census;
  • medium concentration (2_MC): municipalities with a population exceeding 5,000 inhabitants and not exceeding 50,000 inhabitants according to the latest census;
  • low concentration (3_BC): municipalities with a population not exceeding 5,000 inhabitants according to the latest census.
In some specific cases, the degree of concentration of an individual municipality may differ from the classification described above, following requests submitted by the relevant distribution system operator pursuant to Article 4, paragraph 4.2, of Resolution No. 128/99 of 1 September 1999 and approved by the Authority.
The municipal value should not be interpreted as specific to each individual municipality, but rather as an average value for all municipalities within the same province having the same degree of concentration.

RSE processing based on data from ARERA
